name: Beauty's Mercy
descriptionTemplate: Gain [Block:Arg1] Shield. Gain [Arg2] Tentacle. {Aftershock}: Gain an amount of Aliemus equal to the current Tentacle Count.
lore:
"No, no. This is not the logic of creation."
The sculptor spoke in a low voice but dared not look directly into the young apprentice's eyes.
What kind of eyes they were—
Calm as the ocean at the world's end, capturing the struggles of dying migratory birds.
She knows everything, yet remains silent.
